chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, from his brother al-Ḥusayn, from ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, who said:

I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about a man who forgets to pronounce the iqāmah for the salat (prayer) after he has already begun the salat (prayer). He said: “If he has finished his salat (prayer), then his salat (prayer) is complete; but if he has not finished his salat (prayer), then let him repeat.”
Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan said: This report as well is to be understood as referring to recommendation, on the basis of the reports that we have previously presented.

key_terms.تَمَّتْ: has become complete or validly concluded
key_terms.يُقِيمَ: to pronounce the iqāmah before salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets the iqāmah and has already started the salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of one who forgets the iqāmah and begins the salat (prayer). The Imam عليه السلام states that if the prayer has been completed, it is valid, and if not completed, it should be repeated; Shaykh al-Ṭūsī then explains that this is to be understood in the sense of recommendation based on other reports.
